blind.B1: Yes. Human vastus lateralis biopsies after a bout of exercise, with H1/H2 blockade vs control (abstract, PMID 27061420). Exercise factor: post-exercise vs pre biopsies in all subjects; paper full text not available, only abstract.
blind.B2: Abstract: exercise vs baseline (>3000 protein-coding DEGs); control vs blockade post-exercise (795 DEGs). Group sizes not in abstract; GEO design suggests 8+8 subjects.
blind.B3: Likely yes: same subject sampled at several time points (pre/post), so the subject is the unit. Packet A lists no candidate key (no matrix/metadata fields flagged).
blind.B5: Not in the abstract. Reported counts: >3000 protein-coding genes responding to exercise; 795 genes different between control and blockade.

checks.evidence: Abstract (PMID 27061420): human vastus lateralis, exercise vs pre; design supports exercise contrasts. Decision is a stop for missing matrix, not a refusal.
No model fitted; recorded design 16 subjects x 3 times (8 CON, 8 HIST) matches abstract-level design.
No contrast fitted; planned contrasts are post vs pre (exercise vs baseline).
Recorded repeated-measure unit = subject (3 biopsies); discrepancy note says key must be drug+subject id because ids 4,5 occur in both arms. Matches my blind B3.
Drug is between-subject; no batch information assessed; nothing fitted.
Abstract gives no rule; record states 'not stated in abstract', not invented.
No ours-vs-paper numbers claimed; abstract counts (>3000, 795) listed as unreproduced, with note about 2018 updated analysis.

Claim is 'matrix unavailable' (HTTP 403 on all GEO paths, sandbox on/off, EBI and ENA checked). Search was wide; holds. Minor: execute crashed before recording gates, so stop was recorded via record_stop.py.

human_items: Count matrix must be placed in data/GSE71972 (GSE71972_Protein_Coding_Full_Counts_Updated_20160830.xlsx) from a network that can reach GEO, then rerun; use subject key = drug + subject id.
summary: 本案例因GEO文件服务器返回403而在ownership门停止,属于缺文件而非科学性拒绝,停止理由成立且检查范围足够广。设计(16名受试者×3个时间点,受试者为重复测量单位,键为药物+受试者ID)与摘要一致,未捏造阈值或DEG数。总体通过,需在可访问GEO的环境补齐矩阵后重跑。
